_comment: LTX-2.5 text-to-video ComfyUI API-format workflow. Derived node-for-node from the OFFICIAL template at github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_ltx2_5_t2v.json (fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com), converted to the API ('prompt') format ComfyUI's POST /prompt endpoint expects. {{PROMPT}} into node 376 (PrimitiveStringMultiline). {{SEED}} into node 339's noise_seed (low-res pass; the high-res pass, node 338, always uses the template's fixed seed 42, exactly as in the official template). {{WIDTH}} into node 372, {{HEIGHT}} into node 360, {{FPS}} into node 361. {{FRAMES}} into node 362 - NOTE: this is DURATION IN SECONDS, not a raw frame count (the official template computes the real frame length internally as duration*frame_rate+1 via node 378's ComfyMathExpression) - ComfyUIProvider._generate must pass duration seconds here for local_model='ltx25', unlike the raw pre-computed frame count it passes for Wan2.2. {{FILENAME_PREFIX}} into node 75 (SaveVideo). The audio branch (358/366/340/377/367/369) is kept with its real official-template values even though VOXini does not use the AUDIO output yet, per instructions not to remove nodes from the middle of the graph. Requires models from the GATED Hugging Face repo https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5: ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (diffusion_models), gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors (text_encoders), ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors + ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors (vae), ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors (latent_upscale_models). FIX (live-verified 2026-09-27, VOXini test run, prompt_id d30bd251.../e501bbc3...): the official template's optional prompt-enhancer branch (TextGenerateLTX2Prompt node 380 + its CLIPLoader node 393 + ComfySwitchNode node 382 + PrimitiveBoolean node 383 + PreviewAny node 381) has been REMOVED here - node 380 requires ~11 additional numeric/boolean widgets whose exact input key names could not be determined from the official UI JSON (left unset, which fails ComfyUI's 'required input missing: max_length' validation even while the switch is set to bypass it, since ComfyUI validates the whole submitted graph, not just the branch actually taken), and node 393's referenced clip file (gemma4_e2b_it_int8_convrot.safetensors) does not match any file this project instructs the user to download. Node 364 (CLIPTextEncode, positive) now reads directly from node 376 (the raw {{PROMPT}} text) instead of via the removed switch - i.e. prompt-enhancement is permanently off in this template. This exact configuration was submitted to a real running ComfyUI instance and completed successfully, producing a correct video matching the prompt. LTXVDualCFGGuider (nodes 391, 388) video_cfg/audio_cfg values cross-checked against docs.comfy.org/built-in-nodes/LTXVDualCFGGuider. ComfyMathExpression's formula-string widget is emitted as 'expression' by best-effort naming (values.a/values.b/values.c input names are confirmed directly from the source JSON). CreateVideo (node 370) has a second widgets_values entry (8) in the source with no corresponding named input in the UI JSON; left out, no observed ill effect in the live test.
